Amend an accepted study

Source: R/submissions.R
amend_study.Rd

Refinements during a review go through the same door as extractions: a small submission that changes an accepted study, accepted with accept_submission(). Use it to add a fact to groups (e.g. onset after it was added to the form), link subgroups to their parent group, add a group that was not extracted the first time, or add or correct data points. When accepted, the provenance and verification of everything that did not change are kept.

Usage

amend_study(
  path = ".",
  study_id,
  person,
  groups = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  remove_data = NULL,
  metadata = NULL,
  note = "",
  channel = "amendment"
)

Arguments

path

Project root.

study_id

Accepted study to amend.

person

Person making the amendment.

groups

List of groups to change or add, each a list with group_id and the fields to set, e.g. list(list(group_id = "pe_early", parent_group_id = "pe", onset = "early")). Fields of existing groups not mentioned are kept.

data

Data frame (or list) of data points to add, or to replace (matched by measurement_id).

remove_data

measurement_ids of data points to remove.

metadata

Named list of other metadata fields to replace.

note

Why the study was amended (stored in submission.yml).

channel

Channel name. Defaults to "amendment".

Value

The extraction id of the amendment, invisibly.
